post.summary: Creates a new pet profile in the system.
post.description:
This method validates and stores the pet's information, including basic details,
health records, and any initial notes or codes. The pet is automatically
associated with the specified customer.

Returns the created Pet object with all fields populated.
Throws INVALID_ARGUMENT if required fields are missing or invalid.

parameters.name: customerId
parameters.description:
ID of the customer who owns the pet
Required. Must be a valid customer ID

get.summary: Retrieves detailed information about a specific pet.
get.description:
Returns all pet data including health records, notes, and service history.
Throws NOT_FOUND if the pet ID or customer ID doesn't exist.

parameters.name: customerId
parameters.description:
ID of the customer who owns the pet
Required. Must be a valid customer ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier of the pet to retrieve
Required. Format: "pet_" followed by random characters

put.description:
Modifies the details of an existing pet, including basic information,
health records, and any associated notes or codes.

Returns the updated Pet object with all fields populated.
Throws NOT_FOUND if the pet ID or customer ID doesn't exist.
Throws INVALID_ARGUMENT if provided fields are invalid.

parameters.name: customerId
parameters.description:
ID of the customer who owns the pet
Required. Must be a valid customer ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier for the pet
Format: "pet_" followed by random characters

post.summary: Adds special handling codes or medical alerts to a pet's profile.
post.description:
These codes are displayed prominently during service delivery to ensure
appropriate handling and care. Returns the newly added codes.
Throws NOT_FOUND if the pet ID or customer ID doesn't exist.

parameters.name: customerId
parameters.description:
ID of the customer who owns the pet
Required. Must be a valid customer ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier of the pet
Required. Format: "pet_" followed by random characters

post.summary: Adds new notes to a pet's profile.
post.description:
Notes can include observations about behavior, preferences, or special
requirements. Returns the newly created notes with generated IDs.
Throws NOT_FOUND if the pet ID or customer ID doesn't exist.

parameters.name: customerId
parameters.description:
ID of the customer who owns the pet
Required. Must be a valid customer ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier of the pet
Required. Format: "pet_" followed by random characters

post.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of notes for a specific pet.
post.description:
Notes are returned in reverse chronological order (newest first).
Returns an empty list if the pet has no notes.

parameters.name: customerId
parameters.description:
ID of the customer who owns the pet
Required. Must be a valid customer ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier of the pet
Required. Format: "pet_" followed by random characters

post.summary: Lists all pets belonging to a specific customer.
post.description:
Returns a list of pet profiles associated with the customer.
Returns an empty list if the customer has no pets.

parameters.name: customerId
parameters.description:
ID of the customer whose pets to list
Required. Must be a valid customer ID

post.summary: Lists all pets across all customers in the company.
post.description:
Results can be filtered by customer IDs and are paginated.
Requires company-level access permissions.

WeightUnit.description:
Supported weight units. Each unit can be converted to others
using standard conversion factors.

 - UNIT_UNSPECIFIED: Not intended for direct use
 - KILOGRAM: Kilograms, base unit for weight
1 kg = 2.20462 lbs
 - POUND: Pounds, common in US and some other regions
1 lb = 0.453592 kg

year.description:
Year of the date. Must be from 1 to 9999, or 0 to specify a date without
a year.

month.description:
Month of a year. Must be from 1 to 12, or 0 to specify a year without a
month and day.

day.description:
Day of a month. Must be from 1 to 31 and valid for the year and month, or 0
to specify a year by itself or a year and month where the day isn't
significant.

typeDate.description:
* A full date, with non-zero year, month, and day values
* A month and day value, with a zero year, such as an anniversary
* A year on its own, with zero month and day values
* A year and month value, with a zero day, such as a credit card expiration
date

Related types are [google.type.TimeOfDay][google.type.TimeOfDay] and
`google.protobuf.Timestamp`.
typeDate.title:
Represents a whole or partial calendar date, such as a birthday. The time of
day and time zone are either specified elsewhere or are insignificant. The
date is relative to the Gregorian Calendar. This can represent one of the
following:

startTime.description:
Optional. Inclusive start of the interval.

If specified, a Timestamp matching this interval will have to be the same
or after the start.

endTime.description:
Optional. Exclusive end of the interval.

If specified, a Timestamp matching this interval will have to be before the
end.

typeInterval.description:
Represents a time interval, encoded as a Timestamp start (inclusive) and a
Timestamp end (exclusive).

The start must be less than or equal to the end.
When the start equals the end, the interval is empty (matches no time).
When both start and end are unspecified, the interval matches any time.

The pagination object provides a standardized way to handle paginated results
across all API endpoints. It supports both cursor-based and offset-based
pagination, with configurable page sizes and sorting options. This ensures
consistent and efficient data retrieval for large result sets.

v1Pet.description:
Pet represents a customer's pet that receives services at your business.
Each pet has its own profile containing essential information for providing
appropriate care, including health records, behavior notes, and service preferences.

v1PetNote.title:

preferences, or special requirements

v1PetStatus.description:
Status indicates whether the pet is currently receiving services.
This affects appointment scheduling and service availability.

 - STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: Unknown or unspecified status
 - ALIVE: Pet is currently receiving services
Default status for new pets
 - PASSED_AWAY: Pet is no longer receiving services
Historical records are maintained

v1PetType.description:
Type defines the species of the pet.
This helps determine appropriate services, care requirements, and pricing.

 - TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Unknown or unspecified pet type
 - OTHER: Pet type not listed in standard categories
Requires special handling and service customization
 - DOG: Canine companion
Common breeds include Labrador, German Shepherd, Golden Retriever
 - CAT: Feline companion
Includes all domestic cat breeds
 - BIRD: Avian pet
Includes parrots, canaries, finches, etc.
 - RABBIT: Domestic rabbit
Requires specific grooming and handling techniques
 - GUINEA_PIG: Guinea pig
Small rodent requiring gentle handling
 - HORSE: Equine
Requires specialized facilities and care
 - HAMSTER: Hamster
Small rodent with specific handling needs
 - RAT: Rat
Intelligent rodent requiring social interaction
 - MOUSE: Mouse
Small rodent needing careful handling
 - CHINCHILLA: Chinchilla
Requires special dust baths and temperature control

The weight object provides a standardized way to represent and convert
weight measurements throughout the system. It supports multiple units
and ensures consistent weight tracking for pets, products, and other
resources that require weight measurements.
